name: Physical Supremacy, Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 8, druid 8, psychic 8, shaman 8, sorcerer/wizard 8

Duration 10 min./2 levels

This spell functions as physical superiority, except as noted above and the bonus provided is 1/2 your caster level.
